# Comparing two microbial communities {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note title="Question" icon=false}
**How do community composition and diversity differ between two groups?**
:::

Work through a free example with synthetic microbiome data. You’ll compare which features are present and how abundant they are relative to one another, then examine diversity within each sample.

[See the example results](examples/community-comparison/01-see-the-result.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
